findings.title: STATUS.md Done section last 3 entries (2026-08-11, 2026-08-02, 2026-07-31) are in reverse-chronological order, breaking the ascending pattern
findings.detail: The STATUS.md Done section runs in ascending chronological order from 2026-05-15 through 2026-07-13, then abruptly lists 2026-08-11 before 2026-08-02 before 2026-07-31. The correct order should be 2026-07-31 → 2026-08-02 → 2026-08-11. This appears to be an insertion ordering bug from the 2026-08-11 audit — the 2026-08-11 session entry was prepended rather than appended, then the 2026-08-02 and 2026-07-31 entries followed. Readers expect ascending order to navigate history.
findings.fix_sketch: Reorder the three Done section entries so they read 2026-07-31 → 2026-08-02 → 2026-08-11 in ascending order. Then append the 2026-08-22 nightly audit entry.
